sections.name: setup
sections.title: Preparing the test database
sections.what: Points tests at a private schema, rebuilds it from scratch and applies migrations before any test runs.
sections.why: Likely reason: every test run starts from the same known database structure.
sections.watch_out: The schema is dropped on every run, so never point the setting at a schema with real data.

summary: A setup step that runs once before database tests, creating a fresh test-only schema and applying the database migrations to it.
purpose: Ensures tests never touch the development database and always start from the same database structure.
why: The file header says tests never touch the dev schema and never use the network.
how: Loads the local and default environment files. Reads the database address and adds the vitest schema to it, stopping with a clear message if it is missing. Drops and recreates the vitest schema, then runs the migration tool. Any failure is turned into a message suggesting the database be started.
inputs: DATABASE_URL from environment files, and a running local Postgres database.
outputs: A fresh vitest schema with the migrations applied, and an updated DATABASE_URL in the running process.
risks: Drops the entire vitest schema on every run. If pointed at a schema holding real data, that data is lost. Needs the Prisma command line available through npx.
debug: If the setup error says DATABASE_URL is not set, run the init script or the database start command named in the message. If migration fails, check that Postgres is running and read the error text printed with it.
